hints.title: Special Character Mapping
hints.text: Map special entity codes to characters: " to ", ' to ', & to &, > to >, < to <, ⁄ to /.

hints.title: Order of Replacement
hints.text: Ensure & is replaced in a way that does not cascade or interfere with other entities, or parse the string linearly in a single scan.

hints.title: Single Pass Parsing
hints.text: Scan the string once. When an ampersand is encountered, match against the entity table and advance the index past the entity.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Cascaded string replacement like replacing & first could turn &gt; into > which would incorrectly be replaced again.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A single-pass linear scan consumes text token by token without cascading side effects.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate uses single-pass tokenization or linear window scans to avoid double parsing.
complexity.notes: Entities always start with & and end with ;.

solutions.approach: single-pass token scan with entity lookup
